# ROUT — full reference for AI assistants

> ROUT is the Sovereign Digital Identity & Routing OS: one verified identity, private aliases, workspaces for organisations, dynamic short links and QR codes, sovereign booking agendas and "Login with ROUT". Members own their identity; agents act only for a consenting human.

## Ground rules for agents

- Never ask a user for their password or e-mail on ROUT's behalf. Send them to https://rout.be/connect to grant scopes.
- Access tokens carry agent scopes only when a human delegated them; they are valid for at most 1 hour.
- Publishing a profile and verifying identity are always human steps.
- HTTP 202 with `{"status":"human_action_required","action_url":"…"}`: show the action_url to the user and wait.
- HTTP 402 with `{"upgrade_url":"…","reason":"…"}`: explain the reason and show the upgrade_url.

## Discovery endpoints

- OpenAPI: https://rout.be/.well-known/openapi.json
- OpenID configuration: https://rout.be/.well-known/openid-configuration
- OAuth 2.1 + PKCE consent: https://rout.be/connect
- MCP server: https://rout.be/api/mcp
- Sitemap index: https://rout.be/sitemap.xml (sub-sitemaps: sitemap-static.xml, sitemap-profiles.xml, sitemap-workspaces.xml, sitemap-calendars.xml)

## Scopes

| Scope | Allows |
| --- | --- |
| `identity:read_public` | Read the member's public identity |
| `assets:write` | Create QR codes and short links; provision a 48-hour staging workspace |
| `profile:draft` | Prepare an unpublished Studio draft |

## MCP tools

### rout_read_profile (no auth)
Returns public JSON-LD for a profile.
Input: `{ "kind": "verified" | "alias" | "workspace", "handle": "<2-48 chars, no @>" }`

### rout_generate_qr (`assets:write`)
Creates a tracked QR code or short link within the member's plan limits.
Input: `{ "target_url": "https://…", "label"?: string, "kind"?: "qr" | "link" }` — only http(s) URLs.

### rout_create_draft (`profile:draft`)
Prepares an unpublished Studio draft. Publishing stays human.
Input: `{ "space": "alias" | "verified", "displayName"?, "tagline"?, "theme"?, "cardStyle"?, "blocks"?: object[] }`

### rout_provision_workspace (`assets:write`)
Creates an unowned staging workspace and returns a single-use claim URL. Unclaimed workspaces are deleted after 48 hours.
Input: `{ "name": string, "slug": "lowercase-with-hyphens", "description"?: string }`

Example call:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"rout_read_profile","arguments":{"kind":"workspace","handle":"delplanche-group-hwy7"}}}
```

## Machine-readable profiles

Request any public profile URL with `Accept: application/json` to receive schema.org JSON-LD instead of HTML.

Member profile (`https://rout.be/@jona`):

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "ProfilePage",
  "mainEntity": {
    "@type": "Person",
    "name": "Jona Peeters",
    "alternateName": "@jona",
    "url": "https://rout.be/@jona",
    "sameAs": ["https://mastodon.social/@jona", "https://github.com/jona"]
  }
}
```

Workspace (`https://rout.be/w/acme-x7k2`):

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Organization",
  "name": "Acme",
  "url": "https://rout.be/w/acme-x7k2",
  "logo": "https://…/logo.png"
}
```

Linked agenda (`https://rout.be/u/jona/agenda`):

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Service",
  "name": "Agenda van @jona",
  "provider": { "@type": "Person", "alternateName": "@jona", "url": "https://rout.be/u/jona" },
  "url": "https://rout.be/u/jona/agenda"
}
```

Sovereign agendas (`https://rout.be/a/<id>`) are deliberately unlisted and never reveal their owner.

## Anonymous questions: public reference only

ROUT anonymous Q&A hides account details from recipients; it does not guarantee untraceability or prevent recognition from message content. Receiving is off by default. Published audience settings permit everyone, signed-in members or verified members, tightened by account and parental restrictions. Root and alias canvases are separate. Saving a Studio draft does not publish it.

Questions are limited to 300 characters, answers to 1,000. Per-IP submission limits are five per minute and twenty per hour; rewriting has separate limits of three per minute and twenty per hour. Technical sender recognition supports silent muting without exposing sender identifiers to recipients. A send confirmation does not establish delivery or reading.

Ghost Mode is optional: the sender starts rewriting, reviews or edits the proposal, can restore the original, and explicitly sends. The configured external service (Infomaniak AI Tools by default, configurable) processes the submitted draft, instructions and optional language hint, not the full ROUT profile or inbox. If no usable model output is available, a rule-based filter may be used; a failed request leaves the draft unchanged. Neither result guarantees anonymity, accurate meaning preservation or personal-data removal. Do not infer external retention policies from ROUT's no-text-logging behavior.

Only explicitly published question/answer pairs are public. The 24-hour story ring is not automatic deletion of the profile answer. Downloaded story cards and screenshots cannot be remotely recalled. Public documentation and ai_ready metadata grant no private inbox, sender or mute access; Ghost Mode grants no agent authority to send or publish.

References:
- https://rout.be/about/anonymous-questions
- https://rout.be/about/responsible-ai
- https://rout.be/info/anonymous-questions
- https://rout.be/info/answers-and-stories
- https://rout.be/info/ghost-mode
- https://rout.be/safety/anonymous-questions

## Crawling boundaries

- Dashboards, the Studio editor, `/connect` and internal APIs are disallowed in robots.txt.
- Privacy aliases and sovereign agendas are not listed in the sitemap.
- Profiles marked private, suspended or unverified are not listed.
